# Maximum Wall Thickness

Maximum distance between opposing surfaces.

<figure markdown="span">
![Maximum Wall Thickness: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-wall-thickness-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Maximum Wall Thickness: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-wall-thickness-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Thickest section, measured as the largest sphere that fits inside the part.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | Medium |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "Plastic Injection Molding"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 4.0 mm | 5.0 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PLA | 3.5 mm | 4.5 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | ABS | 3.56 mm | 4.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "ABS: 0.140 in")<br>At most: Not yet sourced |
    | Acetal / POM | 3.05 mm | 4.0 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Acetal: 0.120 in")<br>At most: Not yet sourced |
    | PMMA | 12.70 mm | 14.0 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Acrylic: 0.500 in")<br>At most: Not yet sourced |
    | LCP | 3.05 mm | 4.0 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Liquid crystal polymer: 0.120 in")<br>At most: Not yet sourced |
    | Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics | 27.94 mm | 30.0 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PA | 2.92 mm | 3.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Nylon: 0.115 in")<br>At most: Not yet sourced |

    | PE | 5.08 mm | 6.0 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Polyethylene: 0.200 in")<br>At most: Not yet sourced |
    | PSU | 4.57 mm | 5.5 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PP | 3.81 mm | 4.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Polypropylene: 0.150 in")<br>At most: Not yet sourced |

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 5 mm | 7 mm | Aim for: Published, [3DPrintUK](../../citations/bibliography.md#threedprintuk-sls "5 mm recommended maximum")<br>At most: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "Hollow walls over 7 mm") |
    | TPU | 10 mm | 20 mm | Aim for: Engineering judgement<br>At most: Published, [Materialise](../../citations/bibliography.md#materialise-tpu "Hollow parts with walls over 20 mm") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "Plastic Injection Molding"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thick Section (`{measured}`): This exceeds the recommended `{target}`. Thick regions cool significantly slower than surrounding geometry, often resulting in "sink marks" or internal voids as the plastic shrinks.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Excessive Wall Thickness (`{measured}`): This region will cause severe non-uniform cooling. Expect high internal stresses, potential warping, and significantly increased cycle times to ensure the core is solidified.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thick section (`{measured}`): over the recommended `{target}`. Thick sections hold heat in the powder bed and shrink more as they cool, so they can warp or sink. Hollow it out (with escape holes) or core it.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Section too thick (`{measured}`): over `{limit}`. Expect warping and sink as it cools. Hollow it out, leaving walls of about 2 mm and escape holes, or replace the solid with a lattice.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
